notes: 2026-10-04 lane OPS-FIXES: (1) FIXED in scripts/install_systemd_units.sh. The role read at line 75 AND a second copy at line 473 (_VM_ROLE) both leaked. The read is now `{ tr -d '[:space:]' < $VM_ROLE_FILE; } 2>/dev/null || true`, so a missing file is silent and the role reads empty, as before. Negative control: the origin/main script printed 2 ict-vm-role lines on stderr and the fixed one prints 0. tests/test_install_systemd_units.sh adds 3 checks, including a positive control that a present 'gateway' file still takes the gateway path. (2) FIXED in scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh. Before the fetch, when .git/gc.log exists, it runs `timeout ${GIT_PRUNE_TIMEOUT_S:-300} git prune --expire=1.hour.ago`, removes gc.log only on success, and only warns on failure, so the pull is never blocked. 3 tests cover this, including the failure path. Observation that clears the row: after merge and deploy, an ict-git-sync journal for a unit-refreshing deploy shows neither 'ict-vm-role: No such file' nor 'gc.log'. One log line, 'running a bounded git prune', is expected on the first tick.

what: [deploy hygiene, low] Two noise lines on every git-sync deploy of the live VM, MEASURED 2026-10-03T10:21Z (diag journalctl?unit=ict-git-sync.service): (1) `scripts/install_systemd_units.sh: line 75: /etc/ict-vm-role: No such file or directory` -- the `2>/dev/null` on that line guards `tr`, not the shell's input redirect, so the missing role file prints an error on every unit refresh and _VM_ROLE_EARLY silently reads empty; (2) git on the VM clone warns `The last gc run reported ... remove .git/gc.log` / `too many unreachable loose objects; run git prune` on every fetch -- auto-gc is disabled until the file is removed, so the clone's object store only grows (disk 39.6% free today, so not urgent). Fix: redirect the role read as `$(cat /etc/ict-vm-role 2>/dev/null | tr -d ...)` or test -r first; add a `git prune && rm -f .git/gc.log` step (or a system-action) once. || BASIS for the disk figure (claim-basis guard, 2026-10-04): 39.6% free = 17.8 GB free of 45.0 GB on / (health snapshot 2026-10-04T07:58:10Z, check `disk`, ctx free_gb 17.83 / free_pct 39.65; n=1 snapshot, the latest at review time).
